verses.english: 4. The Host of a Hundred Felicities

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho sambahulā ujjhānasaññikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṁ jetavanaṁ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā vehāsaṁ aṭṭhaṁsu.
verses.english: Then, late at night, several glorious deities of the host of the fault-finders, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, went up to the Buddha, and stood in the air.

verses.pali: Vehāsaṁ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Standing in the air, one deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
to be other than they really are,
who enjoys what was gained by theft.
You should only say what you would do;

verses.pali: yaṁ na kayirā na taṁ vade;
verses.english: you shouldn’t say what you wouldn’t do.
by which the attentive practicing absorption
The attentive certainly don’t act like that,
for they understand the way of the world.
The attentive are quenched by understanding,
they’ve crossed over clinging to the world.”

verses.pali: Atha kho tā devatāyo pathaviyaṁ patiṭṭhahitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṁ etadavocuṁ:
verses.english: Then those deities landed on the ground, bowed with their heads at the Buddha’s feet and said,

verses.pali: “accayo no, bhante, accagamā yathābālaṁ yathāmūḷhaṁ yathāakusalaṁ, yā mayaṁ bhagavantaṁ āsādetabbaṁ amaññimhā.
verses.english: “We made a mistake, sir. It was foolish, stupid, and unskillful of us to presume to attack the Buddha!

verses.pali: Tāsaṁ no, bhante, bhagavā accayaṁ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṁ saṁvarāyā”ti.
verses.english: Please, sir, accept our mistake for what it is, so we will restrain ourselves in future.”

verses.pali: Atha kho tā devatāyo bhiyyoso mattāya ujjhāyantiyo vehāsaṁ abbhuggañchuṁ.
verses.english: Then those deities, becoming even more fault-finding, flew up in the air.

verses.pali: Ekā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: One deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
with hidden anger and heavy hate,
and no-one here had gone astray:
and that’s who doesn’t go astray.
If you don’t give your pardon
with hidden anger and heavy hate,
I don’t approve of such enmity,
and so I pardon your mistake.”
